subject: planner: enable fix control for enforced (#56414)
summary: This commit flips `Fix46177` default to `true`, so `findBestTask4LogicalDataSource` will (by default) explore both plans that naturally satisfy required physical properties and plans that rely on enforcers (e.g., Sort/Exchange) when `prop.CanAddEnforcer` is true, then choose the cheaper task. Reviewed the change in `pkg/planner/core/find_best_task.go` (incl. the `prop.CanAddEnforcer` recursion, property enforcement via `enforceProperty`, and fix-control map lookup); it is a planner plan-choice change and should not affect SQL semantics/data consistency. Checked later history up to `upstream/master` and did not see subsequent modifications to the `Fix46177` gate itself.
